name: Presentation Production
description: Build a decision-ready presentation from audience and objective through evidence, visual hierarchy, speaker flow, and rehearsal.

tasks.name: Define presentation brief
tasks.objective: Set audience, objective, decision or action sought, duration, venue, constraints, prior knowledge, likely objections, evidence requirements, and delivery format.

tasks.name: Build the argument spine
tasks.objective: Create a concise sequence of problem/context, evidence, options or insight, recommendation or conclusion, objections, and next action appropriate to the brief.

tasks.name: Draft slide system
tasks.objective: Translate the story into slides with one primary purpose each, explicit headlines, restrained text, appropriate charts/images, source notes, consistent hierarchy, and accessible contrast/type.

tasks.name: Verify content and visuals
tasks.objective: Fact-check numbers, quotes, dates, labels, chart scales, image rights, citations, footnotes, and any claim likely to be challenged.

tasks.name: Rehearse delivery
tasks.objective: Time the talk, test transitions and demos, identify dense or confusing slides, prepare likely Q&A, and create fallback paths for technical failure or shortened time.

tasks.name: Produce final deck package
tasks.objective: Deliver presentation, speaker notes, source appendix, handout/export if needed, asset folder, accessibility checks, and version/date ownership.
